name: Frame Embed Demo
tagline: Embed third-party iframes (a YouTube player) from an App window via scoped csp_overrides[frame-src] — with working fullscreen, autoplay and timestamp jumps.
description:
Frame Embed Demo is the minimal reference for the scoped `frame-src` CSP override (forum #343). By default an App bundle's CSP is `default-src 'none'` with no `frame-src`, so **every nested iframe is blocked**. Declaring explicit https origins in `manifest.ui.csp_overrides["frame-src"]` lifts that for those origins only — no wildcards, no paths, max 8.

**What it shows**

- The manifest declaration: `"frame-src": ["https://www.youtube-nocookie.com"]`.
- The **permission delegation chain**: declaring `frame-src` makes the platform scope `autoplay` / `encrypted-media` / `fullscreen` / `picture-in-picture` to the declared origins (response `Permissions-Policy` header + host window iframe `allow` attribute). Your own `<iframe>` inside the bundle must still forward them via its `allow` attribute — this demo's app.js does exactly that.
- **Jump to cited timestamps**: buttons rebuild the embed URL with `?start=N&autoplay=1`, the #343 use case (a research assistant jumping to video moments).

**No Host API calls, no executas, no grants** — this is the smallest possible UI-only Anna App.

⚠️ Local harness parity: `anna-app dev` serves the bundle **without** CSP/Permissions-Policy headers, so embeds work locally even without the declaration. Verify with `anna-app validate` and an online working draft.
